source: CIS v8.1 Safeguard Visualisations (community project, 2025), https://frameworkmaps.org/assets/CISv8.1-Visualisations-2025-5_MattLee.pdf. Elements are the colour-coded shapes on each safeguard's page: orange hexagon -> governanceElements, green rounded box -> coreRequirements, yellow parallelogram -> subTaxonomicalElements, gray trapezoid contents -> implementationSuggestions.
rules: Text is taken verbatim from the shape (whitespace collapsed, trailing period dropped, line-wrap hyphen artifacts joined).
Salmon/red 'do not' octagons and numeric threshold shapes are recorded under governanceElements (thresholds/restrictions are governance by definition).
Blue 'called-out tool' triangles take the bucket of the box that contains them.

Excluded as informational, not elements: title oval, highlighted description banner, related-safeguard circles, conditional diamonds (Or/And/If), pink OS-dependent stars, and the top-right IG / security-function / asset-type / Cost-of-Cyber-Defense boxes.
Where an existing element already matched a PDF shape (case/punctuation-insensitive), the existing string was kept verbatim to avoid downstream churn.

PDF typos corrected: 'Enteprise Assets' (7.3) -> 'Enterprise Assets'; '"Seperate" enterprise workspaces' (4.12) -> 'Separate enterprise workspaces'; a stray 'impact this Safeguard' tail was trimmed from the 15.4 review hexagon.
17.2 has no page in the PDF; its elements are reconciled against the official CIS v8.1.2 text only.
